test_command: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_scan_pilot.py -v
fixture_scope: Three-update tiny FLM/GRU/transformer models and synthetic attempt records, not actual SCAN fits or timing results.
checks: Original weights, mode, gradients and RNG remain unchanged
Warmup excluded from measured exposure; row-stream hash and total counts match the fitting sampler
Nonfinite loss restores RNG and thread count
Incomplete real priority queues refuse before data/model preparation
Failed attempts retain completed cases and failure records; completed reports refuse overwrite
real_priority_refusal: Priority language-control and BabyLM training queues must finish before the SCAN timing pilot
